purpose: Make the Tavern/Inn a gameplay rumor hub where harbor commerce, ledger pressure, and quiet pre-Revolution tension reach the player through trusted speech.

quest_relevant_interactions.speaker: Bess Armitage
quest_relevant_interactions.line: Bess Armitage: Third Toast, then no names. If the lantern burns twice at the wharf, someone chose a side.
quest_relevant_interactions.quest_effect: Completes follow_tavern_whisper and opens the choice of who to trust.

quest_relevant_interactions.speaker: Silas Crowe
quest_relevant_interactions.line: Silas Crowe: Some messages never cross the tavern floor. Watch the rear gate after the second lantern.
quest_relevant_interactions.quest_effect: Records the optional rear service gate discovery.

quest_relevant_interactions.speaker: Nora Vale
quest_relevant_interactions.line: Nora Vale: The folded notice is not for officials. It is for people who know what the Third Toast means.
quest_relevant_interactions.quest_effect: Connects civic notice-board rumor traffic back to the Tavern/Inn.

quest_relevant_interactions.speaker: Jonah Reed
quest_relevant_interactions.line: Jonah Reed: When the tavern shutters close early, count the lanterns on the wharf, not the cups on the bar.
quest_relevant_interactions.quest_effect: Connects tavern rumor culture to the wharf lantern branch.

ambient_barks: A sailor says the Customs man drinks alone now.
Someone bought silence before the cargo changed hands.
No names after the Third Toast.
The harbor bell rang twice, but only one clerk wrote it down.
A merchant paid in coin clean enough to look dirty.
